transcript.text: I want to build a proper career profile I can generate resumes from later. Interview me about my jobs, what I achieved and my skills, and save it somewhere I can keep updating.

I’m using the career-profiler skill to build your reusable career profile. We’ll cover one job at a time, draw out achievements and skills, and confirm each entry before saving it. This session is **guidance-only mode**: I can interview you, but I can’t create or update the saved profile here.

First, choose your automation preference:

- **off** — Profile building and tailored resumes only when you ask. Recommended for your request.
- **alert** — Watch subscribed job sources and flag matches; draft only when asked.
- **draft** — Watch sources and draft resumes and cover letters for your review.
- **prepare** — Also prepare answers to screening questions for you to paste yourself.

Every option excludes submitting applications, logging in, solving CAPTCHAs, or sending your data to job boards.

Which do you want? You can change it later.

This preliminary choice is required by [career-profiler’s SKILL.md](sandbox:/tmp/cp-astra-pfoJhj/SKILL.md): “Step 0: the automation preference (every mode, every session).” Its setup instructions require that preference before the interview begins.
